header.description: Welcome to OneBlock Void Survival, an exciting Minecraft Bedrock adventure where you start floating in a vast empty void with only a single magical block beneath your feet. Mine it to progress through unique biome phases, uncover hidden secret islands, build your dream floating base, and survive the endless sky while unlocking rare rewards, powerful upgrades, and thrilling challenges. Every step of the journey brings new resources, discoveries, and surprises as you expand from a simple starter island into a grand void empire.
header.name: OneBlock Void Survival v1.2 [AllensCreations]
